# `passportsim stop`

Destroy an instance and flush its artifacts.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_stop` | none | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim stop [instance] [--keep-artifacts] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | `<instance>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `keep_artifacts` | `--keep-artifacts` | `boolean` | no | Keep the artifacts (true). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Stop the only running instance

```sh
passportsim stop --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim stop --json -
```

### Stop one instance of several and drop its artifacts

```sh
passportsim stop --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "instance": "p1",
  "keep_artifacts": false
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "instance": "p1",
  "keep_artifacts": false
}
'@ | passportsim stop --json -
```
